http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17926v1.summary: 約数関数 τ(n) に基づく反復関数 T(n) = n + τ(n) における Erdős–Graham の合流問題（coalescence problem）を、約数後継グラフ（divisor-successor graph）における有限レベルの障害および正方形・環状転送写像（square-annular transfer maps）を用いて解析している。合流問題の解決がグラフの連結性、および有限環状系の非自律列に沿った同期（synchronization）と同値であることを示し、平方数を跨ぐオーバーシュートの集合 Eₖ を定義して、R(X) ≤ log X + 2γ + O(X⁻¹/⁴) やモーメント境界などの定量的評価を証明した。修正版 Henriot–Nair–Tenenbaum 定理に基づいた HST 推定値などを用い、大規模なジャンプや二分岐基準についても論じている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17926v1.appendix: 本論文は数論的関数を用いた反復合成を扱っており、興味ある分野のうち「arithmetic dynamics」に強く関連しています。また、非自律的な系における同期（synchronization）の議論は「symbolic dynamics」の側面も持っています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19393v1.title: 有限グラフを定義するための代替的な手法
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19393v1.summary: 本論文では、有限グラフの新しい定義手法として、完全グラフ不変量である「graph linear notation」を提案している。この不変量は、グラフの標準形（canonical forms）を求めるアルゴリズムに類似した手法で構築される。通常のグラフの代わりにこの記法を保存することで、グラフの対称性を考慮した図示の作成や、グラフ同型判定という2つの主要な課題を大幅に簡略化できる。また、彩色やグラフパスといった古典的なグラフ理論の概念を、この記法へ移植可能であることも示している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19393v1.appendix: 本論文はグラフの構造を線形な文字列表現で定義する手法を扱っており、興味ある分野のうち「combinatorics on words」や「formal languages」といった、語の組合せ論や形式言語理論の観点から関連性を持ち得る内容です。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17885v1.title: 一般線形群における非一次的サイクリック共役類の積
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17885v1.summary: 体 K 上のサイクリック正方行列 C が C = A ⊕ B (dim A = m, dim B = k, m, k ≠ 0) と分解できるとき、これを (m,k)-サイクリックと定義する。本論文では、一般線形群 GL(m+k, K) における2つの正則な (m,k)-サイクリック共役類 Ω と Ψ の積が、行列式が det P = det ΩΨ を満たすすべての非スカラー行列 P を含むことを示している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17885v1.appendix: 本論文は一般線形群の代数的構造を扱っており、提示された興味ある分野の中では「structure of large countable infinite group」に関連する基礎的な行列群の性質を記述しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17880v1.title: 動力学系における対相関統計
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17880v1.summary: 区間上の写像によって生成される軌道の対相関統計に関する研究。適切な混合性とマルチフラクタル性の仮定の下で、軌道の対相関統計が独立同分布（i.i.d.）な確率変数列とほぼ確実に同様の漸近的振る舞いを示すことを明らかにした。この結果はGibbs-Markov写像やガウス写像に適用可能である。また、混合性が遅い系において対相関統計がi.i.d.列とは異なる振る舞いをする例も提示している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17880v1.appendix: 動力学系の統計的性質を扱っており、興味ある分野のうち complex dynamics や arithmetic dynamics に関連します。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17857v1.title: エルゴード理論と確率論からフラクタル幾何学と力学系へ：Manfred Denkerの業績における諸テーマ
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17857v1.summary: 本論文はManfred Denkerの広範な数学的貢献を概説し、エルゴード理論、確率論、力学系、フラクタル幾何学、および統計学を横断するテーマに焦点を当てている。主な業績として、決定論的システムにおける確率論的振る舞い（中心極限定理や不変原理など）の解析、熱力学形式を用いた幾何学的・測度論的性質の関連付け、転送作用素の手法、および従属性データに対する統計的漸近理論などが挙げられる。理論的発展だけでなく、計算的手法や統計的手法との関連性についても触れられている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17857v1.appendix: 本論文で扱われている熱力学形式やエルゴード理論、フラクタル幾何学における共形測度の研究は、興味ある分野である「symbolic dynamics」および「complex dynamics」と密接に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17811v1.title: UMB: 確率論的モデル検査のための統一マルコフバイナリ形式 (拡張版)
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17811v1.summary: 本論文は、多様な確率システムを表現するための、効率的かつ拡張性に優れた明示的状態ファイル形式であるUMB (Unified Markov Binary) 形式を提案している。従来の確率論的モデル検査ツール間では低レベルのモデル表現を共有する効果的な仕組みが欠如しており、テキストベースの独自形式が相互運用性を妨げ、入出力のオーバーヘッドを増大させていた。UMBは一般的な数学的モデルに基づき、ビットレベルの基本データ構造を用いてエンコードすることで、クリーンで効率的な解決策を提供する。主要なツールへの導入実績に加え、モデルの操作や検証を行うPythonライブラリも提供されており、ファイル形式の効率性と新たな実用的ユースケースの両面で有効性が示されている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17811v1.appendix: この論文は、オートマトン理論 (automata theory) や形式言語 (formal languages) と密接に関連しており、確率的な状態遷移系の効率的な表現方法と相互運用性に焦点を当てています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17794v1.title: アフィン自己同型に対する不変複素構造：コサイクルからの視点
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17794v1.summary: コンパクト複素多様体上の正則微分同相写像が、Γ\G上のエルゴード的なアフィン自己同型Aとbi-Lipschitz共役である場合、その共役はC^∞級であることを証明した。さらにAが弱混合的ならば、誘導される複素構造は左不変となる。応用として、アフィンモデルにbi-Lipschitz共役な正則Anosov微分同相写像の正則性ブートストラップや、高ランク・アーベルAnosov作用の剛性定理の複素解析的類似物を示した。複素構造の保存条件をコサイクル適合関係として捉えることで、不変複素構造と中心化群を共通のℤ²コサイクル・フレームワークで論じており、Damjanovićらによるリプシッツ中心化群剛性定理の複素版とみなせる。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17794v1.appendix: 複素多様体上の力学系の剛性や正則性を扱っているため、興味ある分野のうち「complex dynamics」に深く関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17757v1.title: 有限型サブシフトの surjunctive 性および injunctive 性について
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17757v1.summary: 力学系において、単射的な自己準同型が全射的であるとき surjunctive、全射的な自己準同型が単射的であるとき injunctive と呼ぶ。本論文では、ℤ-有限型サブシフト（SFT）を対象に、その既約成分や Cantor-Bendixson 分解を用いた surjunctivity と injunctivity の特徴付けを行う。また、ℤ-SFT が surjunctive であることと Moore 性を持つことが同値であること、および injunctive な ℤ-SFT は常に surjunctive であることを証明する。これにより、Myhill 性を持つ ℤ-SFT は Moore 性も持つことが導かれる。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17757v1.appendix: 本論文は興味ある分野のうち、symbolic dynamics（記号力学系）に直接関連する内容を扱っています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17715v1.title: 対称性の下でのモノイドの双対性
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17715v1.summary: 無限対称群 Sym の作用に対して不変な、無限次元設定におけるモノイドの双対性について研究している。主な成果として、モノイドに対する共変 Minkowski--Weyl の定理を証明した。具体的には、安定化する Sym 不変な鎖に沿った双対モノイドの進化を分析し、それらの共変ヒルベルト基底の最終的な挙動を記述した。さらに、正および非正のモノイドの双対性の特徴付けを含む、双対対称モノイドの構造的特性の体系的な研究を展開している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17715v1.appendix: 本論文は無限対称群 Sym の作用を扱っており、興味ある分野のうち「structure of large countable infinite group」に強く関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17695v1.title: 対称性を考慮したモノイドについて
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17695v1.summary: 無限対称群 Sym の作用に対して不変な無限次元の設定におけるモノイドの研究。主な成果として、任意の Sym 不変モノイドにおける共変有限生成性を特徴づけるローカル・グローバル原理を確立し、従来の先行研究で必要とされていた制約を解消した。また、正値性、正規性、準正規性、単純性といった基本特性に関するローカル・グローバル現象の分析を行っている。さらに、対称モノイドの構造的結果として、正値性の判定条件、単数群の記述、局所対称モノイドの階数および安定化する Sym 不変鎖に関する明示的な公式を導出している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17695v1.appendix: 無限対称群 Sym を対象としているため、提示された興味ある分野のうち「structure of large countable infinite group」に強く関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17693v1.title: 停止性解析を用いた無限状態システムに対するLTLの検証
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17693v1.summary: 本研究は、既存の停止性解析ツールが無限状態システムのLTL（線形時相論理）モデル検査に極めて適していることを示している。提案するフレームワークMoATは、オートマトンベースの標準的な手法を用い、LTLモデル検査問題を「公平な停止性（fair termination）」の問題へと帰着させる。この公平な停止性の証明または反証のために、バックエンドとして停止性解析ツールであるKoATおよびLoATを呼び出す。実験の結果、MoATは無限状態システムのLTLモデル検査における既存の最先端ツールに匹敵する性能を持つことが示された。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17693v1.appendix: 本論文は、興味ある分野のうち「automata theory」に関連しています。オートマトンベースの手法を用いて時相論理の検証を停止性解析の問題に帰着させています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17651v1.title: 2相および4相Golay相補系列の構成法
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17651v1.summary: FiedlerとJedwabによって提案された「3段階構成法」をより一般的な形式へと拡張し、2相および4相のGolay相補系列（GCS）を統一的に生成する手法を提案している。この手法では、長さ2,10,10,20,26の5つの2相シードと、長さ3,5,8,11,13の5つの4相シードを用いることで、特定の長さ（2相では2ᵃ10ᵇ26ᶜ、4相では2ᵃ⁺ᵘ3ᵇ5ᶜ11ᵈ13ᵉ、ここでa,b,c,d,e,u ≥ 0, b+c+d+e ≤ a+2u+1, u ≤ c+e）を持つ既知の系列をすべて構成できるだけでなく、新たな長さの系列も生成可能である。また、構成される系列数についての閉じた式も導出している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17651v1.appendix: 本論文は、特定の性質を持つ系列の構成を扱っているため、興味ある分野のうち「combinatorics on words」に強く関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17605v1.title: 双曲的グラフ、有限表示群、およびその他の空間における粗いメンガーの定理
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17605v1.summary: グラフ理論の基本定理であるメンガーの定理に対し、パス間の距離を離し、カットを有限半径の球に拡張した「粗いメンガーの性質」を検討した。一般にはこの性質は成立しないことが反例により示されているが、本論文ではサイクルの空間が有界な長さのサイクルによって生成されるグラフにおいて、粗いメンガーの性質が成立することを証明した。この結果の系として、双曲的グラフ、有限表示群のケイリーグラフ、面のサイズが有界な平面グラフ、完備リーマン平面などの広範な空間でこの性質が成り立つことを示した。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17605v1.appendix: 有限表示群のケイリーグラフに関する結果が含まれており、興味ある分野である「strucure of large countable infinite group」に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17549v2.title: Petersenグラフから構成される非乗法的upho半順序集合
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17549v2.summary: すべての主フィルターが全体と同型であるような「upho半順序集合」に関し、Fu-Peng-Zhangは、すべての有限的なupho半順序集合がその順序と一致する左簡約可能かつ可逆元を持たないモノイド構造（乗法的構造）を許容するという予想を立てた。本論文はこの予想を否定している。著者らは、任意の点推移的グラフGの頂点を出発点とする歩道から有限的upho半順序集合P(G, v₀)を構築する手法を提案した。PetersenグラフがCayleyグラフではないという性質を利用し、Petersenグラフから構成されたP(G, v₀)が乗法的でないことを証明した。また、Petersenグラフの線グラフから構成された同様の半順序集合は乗法的であることを示し、基礎となるグラフの非Cayley性のみが乗法性を決定するわけではないことも明らかにしている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17549v2.appendix: 本論文は組合せ論（半順序集合、グラフ理論）および群論（点推移的グラフの自己同型群）を扱っており、興味ある分野のうち「combinatorics on words」や「structure of large countable infinite group」に関連する概念を含んでいます。数式表記の変換として、P(G, v₀)やAut(G)を使用しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17525v1.title: 歪んだ列RSK力学とボックス・ボール・システム
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17525v1.summary: 本論文では、Schenstedの列挿入に対するFominの局所規則を2レーンのボックス・ボール・システム（BBS）として解釈し、これを周期的格子上で並列に実行する「skew column RSK dynamics」を定義した。この力学は、歪んだ半標準ヤング盤の対に対する決定論的な時間発展と見なせる。著者らは、この力学がソリトン的な振る舞いを示すことを証明し、時間発展を線形化する陽的な写像（H₁, H₂, κ, ν）を構築した。この線形化座標は、漸近的なソリトンデータ、整数リギング、および弱減少整数列から構成される。さらに、アフィン結晶構造を用いた解析により、古典的なBBSへの射影やソリトン長に関するGreene型の公式を導出し、最終的にHall-Littlewood多項式に関するCauchy型およびKawanaka-Littlewood型の恒等式の全単射による証明を与えた。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17525v1.appendix: この論文は組合せ論（combinatorics）におけるヤング盤の力学系や結晶基底を扱っており、興味ある分野のうち「combinatorics on words」と密接に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17393v1.title: E₈型における完全マッチング、ファノ平面、および直交基底
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17393v1.summary: 本論文では、完全マッチングとラベル付きファノ平面を用いて、E₈ルート系における2025個の正ルートの直交基底を構築・解析している。これらの基底の集合は、一般化されたローテ・図形（Rothe diagrams）の濃度からランク関数を計算できる高度に構造化されたブルハ様（Bruhat-like）の次数付き半順序集合(Ω, ≤_Q)を形成する。著者らは、マッチングやファノ平面の重みなどの組合せ論的統計量を用いてΩの要素のランクを計算する方法を提示し、Ω全体および自然な順序同値関係に基づく50個の同値類に対するランク生成関数の単純な公式を確立した。また、その過程でルート系に依存しない完全マッチングとラベル付きファノ平面に関する独立した興味深い中間結果も導出している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17393v1.appendix: 本論文は、基底の集合を順序集合（poset）として扱い、その構造や生成関数を解析している点において、組合せ論（combinatorics）の分野と深く関連しています。

papers.title: Renormalisation techniques for inflation systems and some of their applications
papers.summary: Exact renormalisation techniques are important and powerful, particularly for inflation-generated systems. We review recent results in this direction. We recall the necessary notions for inflation systems and show the renormalisation principle, which allows us to obtain exact values of highly erratic functions, such as window covariograms. We apply these techniques to compute the diffraction pattern of the new monotile tilings with arbitrary precision. We also recall a recent invariant for system with pure-point spectrum, the orbit separation dimension, and its relation to renormalisation. Lastly, we recall results beyond the pure-point spectrum setting and show how renormalisation and Lyapunov exponents can be used to exclude the presence of absolutely continuous part of the spectra.

papers.title: Formal Verification of Learned Multi-Agent Communication Policies via Decision Tree Distillation
papers.summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables agents to develop coordination strategies through emergent communication, but neural policies lack the formal safety guarantees required for safety-critical robotic deployment in drone swarms and autonomous vehicle fleets. We present the first end-to-end framework for safety verification of learned multi-agent communication policies through policy abstraction: neural policies are distilled into interpretable decision trees, then formally verified, with empirical validation confirming that verified safety properties transfer to original networks. Our four-stage pipeline consists of domain-specific feature extraction from agent observations, decision tree distillation achieving 97.9% +/- 1.2% fidelity to neural policies, automated translation to PRISM probabilistic model checker specifications with complete feature-to-state-variable correspondence, and compositional verification of Probabilistic Computation Tree Logic (PCTL) properties via pairwise decomposition with union-bound aggregation and empirical neighbor modeling. Evaluating Vector-Quantized Variational Information Bottleneck (VQ-VIB) policies for multi-drone coordination with 5-7 agents, we verify 18 temporal logic properties across safety, liveness, and cooperation, achieving 88.9% property satisfaction with all five safety thresholds satisfied (0.3% collision probability vs. 1% threshold). Monte Carlo validation of original neural policies confirms that verified safety properties transfer with <=0.6 percentage-point deviation (95% CI). Discrete VQ-VIB messages provide +11.6 to +13.6 percentage-point fidelity advantages over continuous methods, enabling 3-4x faster verification. Our framework provides empirically validated safety verification for distilled policy abstractions, serving as a practical bridge between deep MARL and formal safety workflows for multi-robot deployment.

papers.title: Outer automorphism groups and the Atiyah Conjecture
papers.summary: Let $G$ be the fundamental group of a compact surface, a finitely generated free group, or more generally a finitely generated right-angled Artin group. We prove that the von Neumann dimension function of $\mathrm{Out}(G)$ is valued in a discrete subgroup of $\mathbb Q$. This is accomplished by establishing the Strong Atiyah Conjecture for a torsion-free subgroup of $\mathrm{Out}(G)$ of finite index. We also prove that for every field $\mathbb K$, there exists a torsion-free subgroup $H \leqslant \mathrm{Out}(G)$ of finite index such that $\mathbb K[H]$ embeds into a division ring, and hence satisfies the Zero Divisor Conjecture. These results are obtained by establishing analogous ones for a suitable open subgroup of $\mathrm{Out}(\mathbf G)$ and its completed group algebra, where $\mathbf G$ denotes the pro-$p$ completion of $G$. In an appendix, the first author shows that an automorphism of a free nilpotent group is inner if and only if it induces an inner automorphism of its pro-$p$ completion.

papers.title: Concave Kite Central Configurations in the Planar Four-Body Problem with Three Equal Masses
papers.summary: We present a complete classification of concave kite central configurations in the planar 4-body problem with three equal masses. There are two different types of central configurations when the fourth mass lies inside or outside the triangle formed by the other three. Using a rigorous computer-assisted analytical method and a fixed coordinate system, we show that the central configurations in each case form a one-parameter family and obtain a complete classification of these configurations. In addition, we rigorously show the existence and types of the bifurcation points in the reduced space. We also provide two numerical global bifurcation pictures in the entire planar 4-body configuration space as the mass ratio varies from $0$ to $+\infty$, including symmetric and asymmetric concave central configurations with three equal masses.

papers.title: Analyzing the Narration Gap in LLM-Solver Loops
papers.summary: Formal tools such as SAT and SMT solvers are increasingly embedded in language model reasoning pipelines when a safety or security critical question can be formulated in logic. Unlike chain of thought whose steps are sampled from the model distribution without formal guarantee, a solver produces a sound and independently verifiable answer. However, the soundness guarantee can be lost in the interaction between the solver and the model. The hybrid pipeline has three components: formalizing the question, deciding it, and narrating the result. Prior work has studied the formalization and decision, but not narration, which is the step that turns a formal tool's output into the user answer. To fill the narration gap, we first model the LLM-solver loop as a verified decision procedure. We further evaluate five open-sourced models under prompt injection, and we find certificate gating makes the solver verdict sound, while an adversary can invert a verified conclusion across phrasings and channels. We study the mitigation through hardened prompt that reduces injection significantly but cannot eliminate it and still suffers under adaptive attack. Combining the formal analysis and empirical studies, we show in the LLM-solver loop, robustness does not reach to the answer that the user finally reads.

papers.title: Several properties of summatory Ehrhart polynomials and series of convex lattice polytopes
papers.summary: In this article, for a convex lattice polytope, we further investigate the summatory function of its Ehrhart polynomial, which is called the summatory Ehrhart polynomial, and introduce its summatory Ehrhart series. We prove several fundamental properties of these invariants. In particular, we derive a summatory analogue of the classical Ehrhart--Macdonald reciprocity law, which establishes a signed functional equation between the polytope and its relative interior via the substitution $t \mapsto 1-t.$

papers.title: Embracing exchange sequences and oriented matroid polyhedron diameter
papers.summary: We reduce the embracing exchange distance of bases of oriented matroids to the metric of oriented matroid polyhedra. This allows us to disprove recent conjectures of Caoduro, Khodamoradi, Paat, and Shepherd and of Bérczi and Nádor. On the other hand, we show that any two embracing bases of an oriented matroid of rank $r$ can be transformed into each other in at most $2r^{\log_2(r)+3}$ steps and in at most $r$ steps in a Lawrence oriented matroid, thus confirming the conjecture in this case.

papers.title: Vancomycert: A Certified Neuro-Symbolic Drug Delivery System (Case Study)
papers.summary: Neural network controllers for autonomous decision-making are well-established in cyber-physical systems, yet their deployment in safety-critical healthcare settings remains largely unverified. This paper presents a methodology and case study for the formal verification of a neural network controller for antibiotic dosing, motivated by the challenge of systems that must be simultaneously adaptive and provably safe across unbounded time horizons. We construct a simplified yet clinically-interpretable model that tracks drug concentration, body temperature, and white blood cell count. Vancomycin is selected as a representative antibiotic, widely prescribed for severe infections yet carrying a narrow therapeutic window, where supratherapeutic concentrations risk nephrotoxicity and subtherapeutic dosing risks treatment failure. A supervised neural network controller is trained on synthetic clinician-style dosing data. We establish formal verification of input-output safety properties, specifically verifying a property of a neural network that implies an infinite-horizon proof that automated dosing never exceeds the supratherapeutic boundary. This system property is proven in Rocq using the Vehicle interactive theorem prover back-end to integrate the different proof systems. The end result is a verification pipeline that allows for a wide variety of treatment approaches whilst maintaining safety for each specific patient.

papers.title: On Cycles in Multiset Permutations, Parking Functions, and Related Structures
papers.summary: In this paper we study cycles in multiset permutations and parking functions. As combinatorial objects, multiset permutations are essential building blocks for mappings and permutations, while parking functions lie between mappings and permutations. We take both algebraic and analytic views in our investigation and present exact as well as asymptotic results. We point to a surprising correspondence between two statistics on multiset permutations, terminal closers and cyclic points, shedding light on the combinatorial structure.

papers.title: Functional completeness and primitive positive decomposition of relations on finite domains
papers.summary: We give a new and elementary construction of primitive positive decomposition of higher arity relations into binary relations on finite domains. Such decompositions come up in applications to constraint satisfaction problems, clone theory and relational databases. The construction exploits functional completeness of 2-input functions in many-valued logic by interpreting relations as graphs of partially defined multivalued 'functions'. The 'functions' are then composed from ordinary functions in the usual sense. The construction is computationally effective and relies on well-developed methods of functional decomposition, but reduces relations only to ternary relations. An additional construction then decomposes ternary into binary relations, also effectively, by converting certain disjunctions into existential quantifications. The result gives a uniform proof of Peirce's reduction thesis on finite domains, and shows that the graph of any Sheffer function composes all relations there.

papers.title: Vertex cuts and median decompositions
papers.summary:
Median decompositions were introduced by Stavropoulos in 2015 as a generalisation of tree decompositions. In this paper, we further develop and exposit this theory as a tool in structural graph theory to study systems of vertex separations.
  Generalising the well-known fact that nested systems of vertex separations produce tree decompositions of a graph over the structure tree, we describe how a (not necessarily nested) system of separations produces a median decomposition. The median graph in this decomposition is the `dual median graph' constructed by Sageev. If the system of cuts is nested then this median decomposition recovers precisely the aforementioned tree decomposition. We prove a theorem asserting that this decomposition is `uniquely minimal', and describe how Sageev--Roller duality manifests in median decompositions.
  As an application of our structural approach, we extend a theorem of Stavropoulos from finite graphs to all graphs, which states that the median-width a graph is equal to its clique number.
  We also describe the link between (canonical) median decompositions and (equivariant) coarse embeddings/quasi-isometries into median graphs. A corollary of these results is a characterisation of when a finitely generated group acts metrically-properly/geometrically on a median graph, in terms of canonical median decompositions of its Cayley graphs.

papers.title: Existential Inclusions of Bi-exact Groups are Conjugacy Representation Rigid
papers.summary: If $Λ$ is a non-amenable bi-exact group and $Λ\hookrightarrow Γ$ is an existential embedding, then each of the intersections $Λ\cap g Λg^{-1}$ for $g$ a member of $Γ\backslash Λ$ is amenable. This in conjunction with work of Bekka and Kalantar demonstrates that in this situation, the weak equivalence class of the quasi-regular representation $λ_{Γ/Λ}$ determines $Λ$ up to conjugacy among the self-commensurating subgroups of $Γ$.

papers.title: Integrated physics-based modeling reveals a thermodynamic gap in small modular reactor load following
papers.summary: Small modular reactors (SMRs) are increasingly considered for flexible power generation; however, many dynamic studies still neglect the thermodynamic coupling between the primary and secondary loops that is essential for accurate assessment of load-following capability. In this study, we develop a hybrid dynamic framework that couples an equation-based model of the NuScale integral pressurized water reactor, including the reactor, primary loop, and moving-boundary helical-coil once-through steam generator, with a physics-based secondary steam cycle comprising the valve, turbine, condenser, and feedwater pump. This approach enforces mass and energy conservation across the coupled system while preserving physically consistent flow interactions across the domain boundary. The integrated model reproduces nominal design-point conditions and is used to analyze a 5% step load rejection under five control strategies, including a decentralized three-loop control architecture for the valve, feedwater pump, and control rods. The results show that partial control strategies are insufficient for efficient and safe operation, whereas simultaneous action of all three actuators stabilizes steam pressure, limits adverse thermal excursions in the primary loop and maintains acceptable steam generator operating margins during load-following maneuvers. Compared with a conventional linear steam-cycle representation, the coupled framework captures dynamic back-pressure and variable turbine enthalpy drop that are otherwise neglected, leading to different predictions of transient behavior and required steam flow. These findings show that thermodynamically coupled, physics-based steam-cycle models are needed for more accurate assessment of the operational flexibility, efficiency and safety margins of SMRs under realistic load-following conditions.

papers.title: NeSyCat Torch: A Differentiable Tensor Implementation of Categorical Semantics for Neurosymbolic Learning
papers.summary:
Neurosymbolic semantics is fragmented: classical, fuzzy, probabilistic and neural systems each define truth by their own inductive rules. NeSyCat, extending ULLER, subsumes them under a single inductive definition of truth, parametric in a strong monad and an aggregation structure on truth-values. NeSyCat has so far lacked an account of predicates and functions learned by neural networks.
  We provide NeSyCat Torch as the missing link and interpret computational symbols via neural networks, implementing the framework in probabilistic programming and tensor-based backends. We use the distribution monad for reference semantics and metric evaluation, and complement it by a monad for numerically stable, differentiable training: the lazy log-tensor monad over the log-semiring. For efficient training in batches, we furthermore employ a batch monad. The axioms are the source code: written once in monad-based do-notation, monadic bind performs marginalisation, lazily pruning unneeded branches.
  On MNIST addition, our HaskTorch, JAX, and PyTorch implementations outperform LTN and DeepProbLog in speed and accuracy, while achieving nearly the accuracy of DeepStochLog. However, unlike DeepStochLog, we stay in a uniform framework that applies to many first-order NeSy approaches. Namely, the construction is parametric in the monad; instantiating it with, e.g., the Giry monad extends the approach to continuous probability (working out a neural representation here is left for future work).

papers.title: Dynamics of simply parabolic inner functions
papers.summary:
We study the dynamics of Polya-Szegö inner functions and discuss some of their basic properties such as equivalent conditions for simple and double parabolicity. We show that a simply parabolic Polya-Szegö inner function admits forward and backward quotient half-cylinders, which allows one to enrich its dynamics with a Lavaurs map.
  To proceed, we restrict our attention to simply parabolic inner functions with finite Lyapunov exponent: $\int_{\mathbb{R}} \log |F'| d\ell < \infty$. We define a geodesic flow on the Riemann surface lamination associated to the Lavaurs semigroup and show that it is ergodic. As an application, we establish the Orbit Counting Theorem up to a Cesàro average for Lavaurs semigroups. If we additionally assume that $F$ is a parabolic one component inner function, then the geodesic flow is mixing and the full Orbit Counting Theorem holds.

papers.title: Markovian actions are Anosov-like
papers.summary: Motivated by the introduction of Anosov-like actions by Thomas Barthelmé, Steven Frankel, and Kathryn Mann, in this paper we study group actions on the plane that preserve a pair of transverse singular foliations, as well as a strong Markovian family, namely, a collection of rectangles serving as an analogue of a Markov partition for group actions. We prove that any such action is Anosov-like. In particular, the existence of a strong Markovian family constrains the behavior of the invariant bifoliation and endows the action with characteristic features of hyperbolic dynamics, such as the existence of infinitely many elements with fixed points.

papers.title: On restricted Rota-Baxter Lie algebras of arbitrary weight
papers.summary: Recently, Ehret and Gilliers introduced the notion of a (trivially) restricted post-Lie algebra, recovering the concepts of a restricted Lie algebra and a restricted pre-Lie algebra. In this paper, we specifically introduce restricted Rota-Baxter Lie algebras of arbitrary weight with an intrinsic graph subalgebra characterization. We show that, via the splitting property, they give rise to restricted post-Lie algebras, and furthermore possess a novel replication property. We then present two natural constructions of such restricted Rota-Baxter structures in prime characteristic: one arising from Rota-Baxter associative algebras of arbitrary weight, and the other from Rota-Baxter Lie algebras of weight $1$. The Rota-Baxter $p$-envelopes of a Rota-Baxter Lie algebra are also examined.

papers.title: Classical freeness of $\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}}_n$ at level $1$ via combinatorics
papers.summary: We use a family of Rogers--Ramanujan-type combinatorial identities of Dousse--Konan involving coloured partitions to prove classical freeness of the simple vertex operator algebras based on $\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}}_n$ at level $1$. These identities are used to produce Gröbner bases for the relevant arc algebras.

papers.title: Explicit thresholds in a generalized Turán problem for \(K_{3,t}\)-free graphs
papers.summary:
For graphs $F$ and $H$, let $\ex(n,F,H)$ denote the maximum number of copies of $F$ in an $n$-vertex $H$-free graph. Janzer, Longbrake and Yepremyan recently proved that, for fixed $3<a\le b$ and sufficiently large $t$, \[
  \ex(n,K_{a,b},K_{3,t})=Θ(n^3). \] We make their threshold explicit, showing that this conclusion holds for all $t\ge τ(b):=2\max\{3,\lceil b/2\rceil\}+1.$ In particular, for every even $b\ge 6$, this matches the necessary threshold $t=b+1$. The main new ingredient is an explicit finite-field point set whose plane sections are controlled directly, rather than through a general bounded-complexity algebraic lemma. This direct line-and-conic section analysis gives the required \(K_{3,t}\)-freeness while preserving many coplanar \(b\)-element subsets.

papers.title: The More the Merrier: Combining Properties for ABox Abduction under Repair Semantics for ELbot
papers.summary: Abduction is a central approach to explain missing entailments from a knowledge base by providing a hypothesis, that would, if added to the knowledge base, make the missing entailment become true. Abduction under repair semantics has recently been investigated in detail, where several desirable properties and optimality criteria were considered, such as signature-restrictions and minimality in size and of introduced conflicts. Naturally, hypotheses that satisfy more than one of these properties or combine a property with an optimality criterion would be even more desirable for applications. So far, such hypotheses have not been investigated in the literature. In the present paper, we consider the ABox abduction problem for hypotheses satisfying more than one property or additional optimality criteria, for EL_bot under brave and AR semantics. Our main observation is that often requiring additional properties for hypotheses does not lead to an increase of complexity.

papers.title: Schur rings over cyclic groups having Almost Commutative Terwilliger algebras
papers.summary: Terwilliger algebras are subalgebras of a matrix algebra constructed from an association scheme. Rie Tanaka defined what it means for a Terwilliger algebra to be almost commutative and gave five equivalent conditions in the case where the association scheme is commutative. A sixth condition for a Terwilliger algebra coming from a commutative Schur ring to be almost commutative has since been discovered. In this paper we first provide a classification of orbit Schur rings that produce an almost commutative Terwilliger algebra for a finite cyclic group. In particular, we show that the subgroup of automorphisms used to form the orbit Schur ring is either trivial, or the whole automorphism group when the cyclic group has prime power order. If the cyclic group has order $2^n$, these are the only options. If the cyclic group has order $p^n$, for an odd prime $p$, then the automorphism subgroup of order $p^{n-1}$ also works. If the group has a non-prime power order then the only orbit Schur ring that produces an almost commutative Terwilliger algebra comes from the trivial subgroup of the automorphism group. We then give a condition for when a wedge product of Schur rings produces an almost commutative Terwilliger algebra. This allows us to determine exactly when a Schur ring over a cyclic group produces an almost commutative Terwilliger algebra.

papers.title: Persistent Entropy of Floer Persistence Barcodes
papers.summary: Floer persistence barcodes provide a quantitative way to encode action-filtered Floer homology. Inspired by the Shannon entropy of persistence barcodes in topological data analysis, we introduce a Floer-theoretic entropy invariant, called \textit{persistent entropy}, which measures the asymptotic linear growth rate, under iteration, of the Shannon entropy determined by the distribution of finite bar lengths. This is complementary to the barcode entropy of Çineli--Ginzburg--Gürel, which records the exponential growth rate of the number of not-too-short bars. We prove that, for Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms, the relative and absolute persistent entropies coincide with the corresponding barcode entropies. For Liouville domains, we prove general comparison inequalities and a subexponential length-growth criterion which gives equality beyond the case of vanishing symplectic homology. We also compute the persistent entropy of cotangent disk bundles of negatively curved manifolds and relate it to the topological entropy of the geodesic flow. In addition, we prove Hofer-stability estimates for finite-level Shannon entropy and derive flexibility and rigidity-type questions for barcode and persistent entropies of Reeb flows.

papers.title: Brave new categorical spectral positive Schubert geometry and the categorical Dual Amplituhedron
papers.summary: This ArXiv preprint of my doctoral dissertation, which, at this stage, has not yet been accepted by the doctoral thesis committee, is intended both to lay the groundwork for a series of papers, and to confirm the existence of a first proposed solution to the "Dual Amplituhedron" problem posed in 2014 by Princeton physicists N. Arkani-Hamed and J. Trnka, a mathematical object which encapsulate the calculation of scattering amplitudes in high-energy particle colliders. The first part of this thesis deals with a rewriting of the positive real Grassmannian and performing the singular gluing of its positroid varieties in a new way via Spectral Algebraic Geometry of J. Lurie on "structured" spaces and a categorification of his "Tannaka Duality for Quasi-coherent Stacks", finding in this formal moduli problem, a compact yet holistic formulation via perverse intersection complexes of P. Deligne. This algebraico-geometric perspective paired with a synthetic differential-geometric perspective, namely the Differential Cohesion of B. Lawvere and U. Schreiber, subsumes infinitesimal thickenings, crystalline cohomology of De Rham stacks, the "Modalities of Structured Geometries" and the unification of their cohomologies of the underlying concrete topological etale algebraic space. The second part uses this rewriting of positive Schubert geometry and "The Cohomology of Brauer-Grothendieck Spaces" of B. Toën and B. Antieau, to show that, instead of the Grassmannian spectral Deligne-Mumford stack which is autodual in the infinity-category of prestable infinity-categories of modules on E\infty-ring spectra, the Amplituhedron, categorified in a functor between infinity topoï, possesses a concrete non-trivial dual, and has a De Rham volume, facts of interest for the expected Duality between the Standard Model of particles and String Theory. This new construction yields the Dual Amplituhedron.

papers.title: Structure-Preserving Schemes for a Fractional SVIR Epidemic Model with a Hybrid Mittag-Leffler-Caputo-Fabrizio Operator
papers.summary:
This paper proposes and analyzes a fractional-order SVIR epidemic model based on a hybrid Mittag-Leffler-Caputo-Fabrizio (MLCF) fractional operator with a nonsingular kernel. This model captures short- and long-term memory effects in epidemic transmission dynamics. The positivity and boundedness of the solutions are proven through an integrated formulation of the MLCF operator and a fractional Gronwall inequality. The basic reproduction number $\mathcal{R}_0$, equilibrium points, and their local and global stability properties are rigorously investigated through Jacobian analysis, logarithmic Lyapunov functionals, and a fractional LaSalle invariance principle.
  To approximate the model, a $θ$-weighted nonstandard finite difference (NSFD) method is developed. This method preserves the continuous system's key qualitative properties, including positivity and boundedness, and is unconditionally stable in the fully implicit case. Consistency and first-order convergence are also proven. Numerical experiments, together with sensitivity and bifurcation analyses, illustrate the impact of fractional memory parameters on epidemic evolution and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

papers.title: Multi-type branching inference on contact trees with application to COVID-19
papers.summary: Inferring epidemiological parameters from transmission trees is essential for understanding infectious disease dynamics. Existing tree-based likelihood methods, including the multi-type birth-death models originally applied in phylodynamic settings, provide powerful tools, but most assume homogeneous mixing and rarely capture how transmission potential changes as an individual infects more of their contacts. In this work, we develop a likelihood framework that operates directly on transmission trees, in which nodes are individuals and edges are reported transmission events, with no sequence data involved. We derive a likelihood for a stochastic SIR process on a rooted contact tree in which each infected individual is characterised by the total number of effective contacts, and the number of already infected downstream contacts. We obtain closed-form ordinary differential equations for the probability that a clade goes entirely unobserved and for the probability density that it produces an observed (sampled) tip in a given state. The resulting likelihood can be evaluated for a rooted contact tree with known tip states, and we extend it to partially resolved trees by treating internal branching times as latent variables. Validation on simulated outbreaks confirms accurate parameter recovery and well calibrated uncertainty. Application to empirical COVID-19 contact-tracing data from Karnataka, India, demonstrates the framework's utility for real epidemiological settings. By incorporating contact-degree heterogeneity in a multi-type branching likelihood, our work provides a principled baseline for inferring both transmission dynamics and contact structure from fully or partially resolved transmission trees, complementing rather than relying on sequence-based phylodynamic inference

papers.title: Peripheral \texorpdfstring{$Θ$}{Theta}-classes and forbidden partial cube-minors of daisy cubes
papers.summary: Daisy cubes are partial cubes whose vertices can be represented by a down-set of a Boolean lattice. This paper gives a label-free characterization: a finite partial cube is a daisy cube if and only if every Djoković--Winkler $Θ$-class is peripheral. The proof orients each $Θ$-class toward a peripheral halfspace and shows that the resulting $Θ$-coordinate labels are closed downward. The characterization turns recognition into a condition on the halfspace structure and gives an exact obstruction formulation: the minimal forbidden pc-minors for daisy cubes are precisely the pc-minor-minimal partial cubes containing a non-peripheral $Θ$-class. We also give an infinite product family of such obstructions. For all $r\ge 2$ and $s\ge 1$, the graph obtained from $P_3^{\square r}\sq Q_s$ by deleting the two opposite corners is a minimal forbidden partial cube-minor for the class of daisy cubes.

papers.title: Completeness for Probabilistic Boolean Tapes
papers.summary: Probabilistic Boolean circuits have recently been proposed as a string-diagrammatic foundation for finite probabilistic programming. In this paper, we present a complete set of axioms for their semantics in terms of Markov kernels. Our approach is based on two intermediate results: completeness for \emph{partial} Boolean circuits and completeness for probabilistic Boolean tapes, a diagrammatic language for rig categories.

papers.title: Explicit constructions for Ramanujan-type congruences
papers.summary: For an integer-valued sequence $\{a(n)\}_{n\geq 0}$ and a prime $\ell$, a Ramanujan-type congruence is a relation of the form $a(\ell n-δ_{\ell})\equiv 0\pmod\ell$, where $δ_{\ell}$ is a specific shift. In this paper, we present explicit constructions of modular forms to establish Ramanujan-type congruences for a broad class of generating functions, including eta-quotients, weakly holomorphic modular forms, and mock modular forms. As applications, our explicit approach provides a unified framework to not only recover known congruences but also establish new non-congruence results and explicit congruences for various combinatorial and arithmetic functions.

papers.title: On monomial resonance
papers.summary: This note addresses the resonance of monomial subspaces. In the first part, we completely characterize the cases where the Fitting scheme structure of the resonance associated with a monomial subspace is reduced, and we further investigate the primary decomposition of the corresponding Fitting ideal. The second part focuses on non-monomial subspaces having the resonance of a monomial subspace.

papers.title: PaSTTeL: Parallel analysiS framework for Termination and non-Termination of Lasso programs
papers.summary: Proving termination or non-termination of lasso programs is a challenging problem in program verification. To unify state-of-the-art approaches under a common execution framework, we present PaSTTeL, a modular and generic parallel portfolio framework for termination and non-termination analysis of lasso programs. PaSTTeL is designed to: (1) facilitate the integration of new analysis algorithms into the portfolio, (2) execute registered strategies concurrently, and (3) act as a self-contained library component that can be seamlessly embedded into any external project requiring (non-)termination analysis. Initial experiments demonstrate that an instantiation of PaSTTeL performs competitively against state-of-the-art tools.

papers.title: A Combinatorial Generalization of a Random-Player Game
papers.summary: In a previous note, a two-player game between a random player and a deterministic player was introduced, and it was shown analytically that the winning probability of the deterministic player is the derangement probability dn/n!. The natural question left open was to explain this coincidence combinatorially. This paper gives such an explanation and extends it to a larger family of games. In the generalized game, the deterministic player removes q elements per turn, or all remaining elements if fewer than q remain. We couple the game exactly to the cycle decomposition of a uniformly random permutation. Under this coupling, the random player wins precisely when the first cycle of length at most q, read in canonical cycle order, is a fixed point. The case q = 1 recovers derangements, while the general case is governed by the first short cycle of the permutation.

papers.title: About the Shadowing Theorem for piecewise smooth vector fields with sliding motion
papers.summary: Since every modeling process in real-world situations is subject to errors, the study of the so-called shadowing property becomes highly relevant. This property allows for the identification of true orbits that closely follow a chain of trajectories in which some degree of approximation is introduced at each step. The objective of this paper is to establish a version of the Shadowing Theorem for vector fields governed by ordinary differential equations in the piecewise-smooth setting, where the dynamics alternate between distinct regimes, or on-off stages. First, we present an example showing that such a result can not be obtained under the same hypotheses commonly assumed in the C2 scenario. Consequently, under appropriate assumptions, we prove a Shadowing-like Theorem specifically tailored to this framework. Furthermore, we propose several extensions of the main result aimed at capturing characteristic phenomena intrinsic to piecewise-smooth vector fields - features that do not arise in the C2 setting.

papers.title: Monadic dependence from reducts, and applications to twin-width of oriented graphs
papers.summary:
We study monadic dependence of binary relational structures including at least one antisymmetric relation.
  Our cornerstone result gives sufficient conditions for proving that a structure is monadically dependent by only considering some of its reducts, assuming they are structurally well-behaved and compatible enough. As an application, we consider some reorientation rules preserving monadic dependence of binary structures, as well as replacement of one antisymmetric relation with bounded independence number by another. Then, we apply our main (technical) result to the study of twin-width in two ways.
  First, generalizing the fact that twin-width boundedness is equivalent to being expandable by a linear order into a monadically dependent class, we prove that it is also equivalent to being expandable by an oriented graph with bounded independence number (for instance by a poset with bounded width or by a tournament), and that FO-model checking is fixed-parameter tractable on such an expansion.
  Second, we show delineation by twin-width for some new classes of oriented graphs, including oriented split graphs and local tournaments. In all these cases, we also obtain fixed-parameter tractability of FO-model checking.

papers.title: Dynamical blanket times
papers.summary:
We introduce dynamical blanket times, which quantify how quickly the empirical distribution along a typical orbit approximates the invariant measure. These can be viewed as a measure-theoretic analogue of the previously introduced \emph{dynamical cover time}, which measures how quickly an orbit becomes dense in the space. Motivated by analogous comparability questions for random walks on graphs, we investigate how much longer it takes for a dynamical system to ``blanket'' than to ``cover''.
  For finite-branch, uniformly expanding interval maps, we obtain upper bounds on the expected blanket time in terms of the spatial scale and the precision of approximation. In the special case where the invariant measure is absolutely continuous with respect to Lebesgue, this yields comparability between the expected blanket and cover times, uniformly across all sufficiently small scales.
  Our approach combines two main ingredients. First, we establish large deviation estimates for hitting times which are uniform over both the target location and the spatial scale. Second, using methods from multifractal analysis, we construct a finite discretisation of the invariant measure which reduces the problem to a suitably controlled discrete model.

papers.title: Surjectivity of Engel Words on $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathcal{O})$ and $\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathcal{O}_2)$
papers.summary: The study of word maps and Waring-like problems has been widely pursued for finite simple groups, algebraic groups, and Lie groups. In this article, we study Engel word maps $e_{m}(x, y) = \left[\cdots\left[[x, y], y \right], \cdots, y \right]$ on certain linear groups over local rings, namely, $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathcal R)$ and $\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathcal R)$. We consider the commutative ring $\mathcal {R} $ to be either a complete, local principal ideal ring $\mathcal O$, or a local principal ideal ring of finite length $\mathcal O_\ell$. Suppose the characteristic of the residue field $k\cong \mathbb F_q$ is $\neq 2$. Under some mild conditions on $q$, we show that there exists a constant $q_0(m)$, such that for all $q \geq q_0(m)$, all lifts in $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathcal{O})$ of non-scalar elements of $\mathrm{SL}_2(k)$, are in the image of the $m$-th Engel word over $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathcal{O})$. We further show that all Engel word maps are surjective on $\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathcal{O}_2)$ where $\mathcal{O}_2$ is a local principal ideal ring of length two. This work generalizes similar results about the Engel word map over fields.

papers.title: Tractable Gap-Constraint Languages for Complex Event Recognition
papers.summary:
For strings $u, D \in Σ^*$, a subsequence embedding of $u$ in $D$ is a function $e \colon \{1, 2, \ldots, |u|\} \to \{1, 2, \ldots, |D|\}$ with $e(i) < e(i+1)$ for every $i \in \{1, 2, \ldots, |u|-1\}$ and the $i$-th symbol of $u$ equals the $e(i)$-th symbol of $D$. A gap-constraint for $u$ is a triple $(i, j, L)$ with $1 \leq i < j \leq |u|$ and $L$ is a regular language over $Σ$. An embedding $e$ satisfies a gap-constraint $(i, j, L)$ if the factor of $D$ strictly between positions $e(i)$ and $e(j)$ is a word from $L$. We investigate the subsequence matching problem with gap-constraints, which is relevant in the context of complex event recognition (CER): given $u, D \in Σ^*$ and a set $C$ of gap-constraints, find an embedding of $u$ in $D$ that satisfies all gap-constraints from $C$.
  In general, subsequence matching is NP-complete and the only known tractable variants restrict the interval structure of the gap-constraints. In this work, we show that we can solve subsequence matching with gap-constraints with an arbitrary interval structure rather efficiently (in fact, optimally under SETH) in time $O(|D| (|u| + |C|))$ if the gap-constraint languages satisfy a property which we dub left-convexity: whenever $u v w \in L$ and $v \in L$, then also $uv \in L$. Left-convex languages are sufficiently expressive to model interesting real-world scenarios considered in CER, e.g., length constraints $L = \{w \mid a \leq |w| \leq b\}$ for $a, b \in \mathbb{N}$. We also show how our algorithm can be used in order to efficiently enumerate all satisfying embeddings, which is particularly relevant for possible applications in CER. Finally, we show how non-left-convex languages can lead to intractability, i.e., if in addition to length constraints we allow $\{aa, ε\}$ as the only non-left-convex constraint language, then the problem is NP-complete again.

papers.title: VERITAS: Verifier-Guided Proof Search for Zero-Shot Formal Theorem Proving
papers.summary: LLM-based formal provers often collapse rich verifier signals (syntax errors, type mismatches, partial goal progress) into a binary pass/fail bit. We present VERITAS, a zero-shot framework that routes every verifier signal back into proof search through a two-phase protocol: Best-of-N sampling first, then a critic-guided MCTS pass that ingests Phase 1 failures as explicit negative examples. The protocol preserves every theorem solved by its own Phase 1 sweep, so Phase 2's additional solves are attributable to feedback-driven exploration. VERITAS reaches 40.6% on miniF2F (vs. an independently run Best-of-5 at 36.9%, Portfolio 26.2%) and 7.3% on VERITAS-CombiBench, a 55-theorem combinatorics benchmark we release on which Best-of-5 (1.8%) falls below Portfolio (3.6%), exposing that unguided sampling hurts when correct lemma names must be recovered iteratively from verifier feedback. Artifacts are available on GitHub.

papers.title: Ehrhart Theory of the Join of Two Lattice Polytopes
papers.summary: Inspired by research on the Cartesian product of two lattice polytopes, this paper investigates the Ehrhart theory of the join of two lattice polytopes. This is also a well-known open problem listed on the website of the American Institute of Mathematics. This paper resolves this open problem. We first construct counterexamples showing that the join of two Ehrhart positive polytopes is not necessarily Ehrhart positive. Then we prove that if two lattice polytopes have the integer decomposition property and the spanning property, then their join also has these two properties. However, the very ample property is not inherited under joins. Finally, we show that unimodular triangulations, regular triangulations, and quadratic triangulations are preserved under the join operation. As a byproduct, we state the necessary and sufficient condition for the Cartesian product of two Gorenstein lattice polytopes to remain Gorenstein.

papers.title: Dyck paths on black-and-white lattices
papers.summary: A Dyck path of semilength $n$ is a lattice path from $(0,0)$ to $(n,n)$ consisting of $n$ right-steps $(1,0)$ and $n$ up-steps $(0,1)$ that never rises above the line $y=x$. These paths are enumerated by the Catalan numbers and play a central role in enumerative combinatorics. We color the cells of the integer grid in black and white according to two natural patterns, namely chessboard and column-alternating, and enumerate the Dyck paths having equal numbers of black and white cells beneath them.

papers.title: Two-Phase Bilevel Search for the Moving-Target Traveling Salesman Problem with Moving Obstacles
papers.summary: The Moving-Target Traveling Salesman Problem (MT-TSP) seeks a minimum cost trajectory for an agent that departs from a static depot, visits a set of moving targets, each within one of their assigned time windows, and returns to the depot. In this article, we study the Moving-Target Traveling Salesman Problem with Moving Obstacles (MT-TSP-MO), a generalization of the MT-TSP where the agent trajectory must avoid moving obstacles. We present a Mixed-Integer Conic Programming (MICP) formulation that can be solved using off-the-shelf solvers, as well as a fast and scalable Two-Phase Bilevel Search (TPBS) algorithm that computes high-quality feasible solutions for the problem. We evaluate our approaches against an existing baseline algorithm on a broad range of problem instances with up to 40 targets and 40 obstacles. The results demonstrate that both the proposed methods significantly outperform the baseline with respect to success rates, solution costs, and computation time.

papers.title: Very large cliques in a scale-free random graph
papers.summary:
In this short article we consider a preferential attachment random graph model with edge steps, studied by Alves, Ribeiro and Sanchis. Starting with an initial graph $\mathbb{G}_1$ formed by a vertex with a self-loop attached to it, the model evolves as follows. At every subsequent (discrete) time step, either with probability $p$ we add a vertex to the graph and connect it to exactly one of the older vertices selected with probability proportional to its degree, or with probability $1-p$ we add one edge between two existing vertices, both selected (independently) with probability proportional to their degrees. Let $ω(\mathbb{G})$ be the clique number of a graph $\mathbb{G}$, i.e.\ the number of vertices in a largest complete subgraph of $\mathbb{G}_{}$. Alves, Ribeiro and Sanchis showed that, for any given $\varepsilon>0$, we have $ω(\mathbb{G}_{2t})\geq t^{\frac{1-p}{2-p}(1-\varepsilon)}$ with high probability (i.e.\ with probability tending to $1$ as $t\rightarrow \infty$). Here we strengthen this bound by showing that, for any function $f:\mathbb{N}\mapsto \mathbb{N}$ that satisfies $f(t)\rightarrow \infty$ as $t\rightarrow \infty$, with high probability
  \[ω(\mathbb{G}_{2t}) = Ω\left(t^{\frac{1-p}{2-p}}\Big(\log^{\frac{1}{2-p}}(t)f(t)\Big)^{-1}\right).\]

papers.title: Perfect Sphere Packing In The Boolean Space
papers.summary: Perfect sphere packing in the Boolean space is a fundamental and complex problem with significant implications for coding theory, cryptography, and discrete mathematics. The classical solution to the perfect sphere packing problem was provided by Hamming via his well-known perfect codes. However, a major limitation of the traditional Hamming metric is its strict applicability, as it allows perfect partitioning only for spaces with specific, highly constrained dimensions. To address this structural limitation, this article introduces a novel distance metric specifically designed for Boolean hypercubes. The proposed metric modifies the topological properties of the space, making it mathematically viable to partition a Boolean space of any arbitrary dimension into disjoint, perfect spheres. We rigorously define the algebraic properties of this new distance function and demonstrate its consistency across various dimensions. Furthermore, we explore the structural characteristics of the resulting packings. This approach bypasses the classical dimensional constraints of Hamming codes, potentially opening new avenues for designing error-correcting codes and cryptographic primitives in non-traditional dimensions.

papers.title: Differential Equation Inductive Robustness Axiomatization
papers.summary: This article establishes the completeness of an axiomatization for the robust safety of dynamical systems with polynomial differential equations on bounded time horizons. Safety properties of robust systems are uniformly reduced to a sound axiomatization of polynomial invariants, resulting in reliable logical proofs of correctness. Approximate decidability results are also established: there is a computable algorithm such that, given any perturbation parameter $δ$, it either produces a symbolic proof of robust safety (hence correctly decides the dynamical system to be robustly safe), or correctly decides that the system is not robustly safe under a perturbation of level $δ$. In contrast to earlier works, this article crucially leverages results from subanalytic geometry to retain a level of exactness, thereby establishing positive results of provability/decidability allowing for arbitrary bounded (semialgebraic) initial/post conditions even without positive separation at their (topological) boundaries. This enables the generation of proofs of inductive safety beyond finite time horizons for general hybrid dynamical systems.

papers.title: Generalization of Selberg's $3/16$ theorem for geometrically finite thin subgroups of $\operatorname{SO}(n, 1)$
papers.summary: Let $Γ$ be a geometrically finite thin subgroup of an arithmetic lattice $Γ_0 < G := \operatorname{SO}(n, 1)$ and consider the congruence covers of $Γ\backslash G$. In the breakthrough work of Bourgain-Gamburd-Sarnak, the expansion machinery was used to establish a uniform spectral gap in the setting $(G, Γ_0) = (\operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb{R}), \operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z}))$ when the critical exponent satisfies $δ_Γ> \frac{1}{2}$. The main applications are affine sieve for $Γ$-orbits and uniform resonance-free half-planes for the resolvent of the Laplacian. These results were generalized in subsequent works by Mohammadi-Oh, Oh-Winter, the author, and Edwards-Oh. Yet, the region $δ_Γ\in \bigl(\frac{1}{2}, n - 2\bigr]$ for $n \geq 3$ remains to be treated when there are cusps. The purpose of this paper is to fill in this gap in the literature. The difficulty lies in working with a countably infinite coding due to the presence of cusps. In particular, we incorporate new tools to prove the Zariski density and full trace field properties of the return trajectory subgroups.

papers.title: Closure operators and geometric modules of valuated matroids
papers.summary: We introduce a closure operator for valuated matroids and prove that it yields a cryptomorphic definition of valuated matroids. As an application, we introduce a class of modules over the tropical semifield (geometric modules) and prove that there is one-to-one correspondence between projective equivalence classes of simple valuated matroids and isomorphism classes of finitely generated geometric modules. We further illustrate how this correspondence can be lifted to simple infinite valuated matroids and geometric modules.

papers.title: DeFAb: A Verifiable Benchmark for Defeasible Abduction in Foundation Models
papers.summary: A rule-based logic solver resolves every instance in our benchmark in under 50 microseconds with 100% accuracy; the best frontier language model reaches 65% at best and drops to 23.5% under rendering-robust evaluation (worst case over four surface renderings). We introduce DeFAb (Defeasible Abduction Benchmark), a dataset and generation pipeline that converts four decades of publicly funded knowledge bases into formally grounded instances for defeasible abduction: constructing hypotheses that explain anomalies by overriding defaults while preserving unrelated expectations. Because every hypothesis must pass polynomial-time checks for valid derivation, conservativity, and minimality, DeFAb makes logical rigor the instrument for measuring creativity and theoretical reasoning, scoring the disciplined construction of theory revisions rather than fluent but theory-destroying prose. The pipeline pairs taxonomic hierarchies (OpenCyc, YAGO, Wikidata) with behavioral property graphs (ConceptNet, UMLS) to produce 372,648+ instances across 33.75M materialized rules from 18 sources, in three levels with polynomial-time verifiable gold standards. Four frontier models do not reliably internalize defeasible reasoning: rendering-robust Level 2 accuracy is 7.8-23.5%; chain-of-thought variance (~36 pp) exceeds any inter-model gap; and a matched contamination control isolates a +19.4 pp Level 3 gap. We further release DeFAb-Hard (a 235-instance Level 3 difficulty variant; best model 53.3% vs 100% symbolic) and CONJURE (a kernel-verified transformative-creativity variant of 560 Lean 4/Mathlib instances whose gold answers are definitions the proof kernel did not previously contain, judge-free verifier; a pilot finds zero novel concepts). The same verifier doubles as an exact reward for preference optimization (DPO, RLVR/GRPO). Released under MIT at https://huggingface.co/datasets/PatrickAllenCooper/DeFAb.

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19645v1.title: インフレーション系に対するくりこみ手法とその応用
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19645v1.summary: 本研究は、インフレーション生成系における厳密なくりこみ手法の最近の成果を概観したものです。まず、インフレーション系の基礎概念を整理し、window covariogramのような複雑で不規則な関数の厳密値を算出可能にする「くりこみ原理」を紹介しています。この手法を応用して最新の単一タイル（monotile）によるタイリングの回折パターンを任意精度で計算する例を示すほか、純点スペクトルを持つ系の不変量である「軌道分離次元」とくりこみの関係についても論じています。最後に、純点スペクトルを超えた設定において、くりこみとリャプヌフ指数を用いてスペクトルの絶対連続成分の存在を排除する手法を解説しています。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19645v1.appendix: 本論文は、興味ある分野のうち symbolic dynamics および combinatorics on words と深く関連しています。特に置換（substitution）によって生成される力学系やタイリングの性質を扱っています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19632v1.title: 決定木蒸留による学習済みマルチエージェント通信方策の形式検証
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19632v1.summary: マルチエージェント強化学習（MARL）におけるニューラル方策は、安全性が重視される自律システムにおいて形式的な安全性保証が欠如しているという課題がある。本研究では、ニューラル方策を解釈可能な決定木に蒸留し、確率的モデルチェッカPRISMを用いてPCTL（確率計算樹論理）プロパティを検証するエンドツーエンドのフレームワークを提案した。5〜7台のドローン群を用いたVQ-VIB方策の評価では、蒸留モデルが97.9%の忠実度を達成し、検証された安全プロパティが元のネットワークへも極めて高い精度で転移することを確認した。これにより、深層MARLと形式的検証ワークフローを繋ぐ実用的な手法が提示された。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19632v1.appendix: 本論文は、確率的モデルチェッカを用いた形式検証を扱っており、オートマトン理論（automata theory）や形式言語の理論的枠組みと密接に関連しています。また、数値的な安全限界の検証という点では、validated numerics の関心領域とも親和性があります。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19606v1.title: 外部自己同型群と Atiyah 予想
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19606v1.summary: コンパクト曲面の基本群、有限生成自由群、または有限生成直角アルティン群 G に対し、その外部自己同型群 Out(G) の von Neumann 次元関数が ℚ の離散部分群に値を持つことを示した。これは Out(G) の有限指数ねじれなし部分群に対して強 Atiyah 予想を確立することで導かれる。また、任意の体 𝕂 に対し、群環 𝕂[H] が斜体に埋め込まれ、ゼロ因子予想を満たすような Out(G) の有限指数ねじれなし部分群 H が存在することも証明した。これらの成果は、G の pro-p 完備化の外部自己同型群とその完備群環における性質を解析することで得られている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19606v1.appendix: 本論文は「structure of large countable infinite group」の分野と密接に関連しており、巨大な可算無限群である Out(G) の部分群構造や、その群環の代数的性質（Atiyah 予想やゼロ因子予想）について重要な知見を提供しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19596v1.title: 3つの等質量をもつ平面4体問題における凹凧型中心配位
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19596v1.summary: 3つの等質量物体を含む平面4体問題における、凹凧型（concave kite）の中心配位を完全に分類した。第4の質量が他の3つの質量が作る三角形の内部または外部にある場合で、2つの異なるタイプの中心配位が存在することを示した。厳密な計算機援用解析手法と固定座標系を用いることで、各ケースの中心配位が1パラメータ族を形成することを証明し、その完全な分類を得た。さらに、簡約空間における分岐点の存在とその種類を厳密に示し、質量比を0から+∞まで変化させた際の、対称および非対称な凹中心配位を含む大域的な分岐図を数値的に提示した。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19596v1.appendix: この論文は「validated numerics（精度保証付き数値計算）」の分野に関連しています。著者らが用いている「rigorous computer-assisted analytical method」は、数値的な計算に数学的な厳密性を与える手法であり、本研究における中心配位の分類と分岐の証明において中心的な役割を果たしています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19532v1.title: Vancomycert: 検証済みニューロシンボリック薬物投与システム（ケーススタディ）
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19532v1.summary: 本論文は、医療分野の安全性要求に応えるため、抗生物質（バンコマイシン）の投与量を制御するニューラルネットワークの形式検証手法を提案している。臨床的に解釈可能なモデルを構築し、教師あり学習で訓練された制御器が、腎毒性を引き起こす過剰投与を回避することを無限時間ホライズンにおいて形式的に証明した。検証にはVehicle対話型定理証明器バックエンドを介したRocqが用いられ、各患者に対する安全性を保証しつつ柔軟な治療を可能にする検証パイプラインを実現している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19532v1.appendix: 本論文は、対話型定理証明器や形式検証の手法を扱っており、計算機科学的な観点から形式言語やオートマトン理論の安全性保証への応用に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19500v1.title: マルチセットの順列、パーキング関数、および関連構造におけるサイクルについて
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19500v1.summary: 本論文では、マルチセットの順列（multiset permutations）とパーキング関数（parking functions）におけるサイクルの構造を、代数的および解析的な両側面から調査しています。マルチセットの順列は写像や順列の構成要素であり、パーキング関数はそれらの中間的な性質を持つ対象です。研究の結果、厳密な計数結果と漸近的な挙動の両方が示されました。特に、マルチセットの順列における「terminal closers」と「cyclic points」という2つの統計量の間に驚くべき対応関係があることが発見され、その組合せ論的構造が明らかになりました。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19500v1.appendix: 本論文は、組合せ論的構造（マルチセットの順列やパーキング関数）を扱っているため、興味ある分野のうち「combinatorics on words」と密接に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19473v1.title: 頂点カットとメディアン分解
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19473v1.summary: Stavropoulos (2015) によって導入されたツリー分解の一般化である「メディアン分解」の理論を、グラフの構造的性質を研究する道具として発展させた論文。入れ子状の頂点分離システムがツリー分解を生成するという既知の事実を一般化し、任意の頂点分離システムからメディアン分解を構成する方法を示している。この分解におけるメディアングラフはSageevの「デュアル・メディアングラフ」と一致し、システムが入れ子状の場合は従来のツリー分解に帰着する。応用として、グラフのメディアン幅がクリーク数に等しいという定理を無限グラフへ拡張したほか、群のメディアングラフへの幾何学的作用とケイリーグラフの標準的メディアン分解の関連についても示している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19473v1.appendix: 大規模可算無限群の構造 (structure of large countable infinite group) と密接に関連しています。具体的には、有限生成群がメディアングラフに対して距離的固有あるいは幾何学的に作用するための条件を、ケイリーグラフの標準的なメディアン分解を通じて規定しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19322v1.title: 双正確群の存在包含は共役表現に関して剛性的である
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19322v1.summary: 非アメナブルな双正確群 Λ から Γ への存在埋め込み（existential embedding）が存在する場合、Λ とその共役群 gΛg⁻¹ の交わり（g は Γ\Λ の元）が常にアメナブルになることを示している。この結果と Bekka および Kalantar の先行研究を組み合わせることで、準正則表現 λ_Γ/Λ の弱同値類が、Γ の自己通約的部分群の中における Λ を共役を除いて一意に決定することを証明した。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19322v1.appendix: この論文は、大きな可算無限群の構造（structure of large countable infinite group）に関連する、群の表現論および幾何学的群論の成果を扱っています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19260v1.title: 単純放物型内部関数の力学系
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19260v1.summary: Polya-Szegö内部関数の力学系を研究し、単純および二重放物性の等価条件などの基本特性を明らかにしています。単純放物型Polya-Szegö内部関数が前方および後方の商半円柱を許容することを示し、Lavaurs写像による力学系の拡張を行いました。特に有限のリャプノフ指数 (∫_ℝ log |F'| dℓ < ∞) を持つ場合、Lavaurs半群に関連するリーマン面ラミネーション上の測地流を定義してそのエルゴード性を証明しました。応用として、Lavaurs半群に対するチェザロ平均を用いた軌道計数定理を確立し、さらにFが放物型1成分内部関数であれば、測地流の混合性と完全な軌道計数定理が成立することを示しています。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19260v1.appendix: 本論文は興味ある分野のうち、複素力学系 (complex dynamics) に強く関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19246v1.title: マルコフ的作用はAnosov的である
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19246v1.summary: Barthelmé, Frankel, Mannによって導入されたAnosov的作用に着想を得て、平面上の群作用を研究している。具体的には、一対の横断的な特異葉層構造と、マルコフ分割の類似物である「強マルコフ族（strong Markovian family）」を保存する作用を対象とする。本論文では、このような作用がすべてAnosov的であることを証明した。特に、強マルコフ族の存在が不変な二重葉層の振る舞いを制限し、不動点を持つ無限個の元の存在など、双曲力学系の特徴的な性質を作用に与えることを示している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19246v1.appendix: マルコフ分割の概念を発展させた強マルコフ族を扱っているため、symbolic dynamicsと密接に関連しています。また、群作用における双曲的な性質を議論している点で、complex dynamicsの分野とも接点があります。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19234v1.title: 組合せ論によるレベル1のsl̂ₙにおける古典的自由性
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19234v1.summary: Dousse--Konanによる色付き分割に関するRogers--Ramanujan型の組合せ論的恒等式を用いて、レベル1のsl̂ₙに基づく単純頂点作用素代数の古典的自由性を証明している。具体的には、これらの恒等式を利用して関連するアーク代数（arc algebras）のグレブナー基底を構築している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19234v1.appendix: 本論文は、提示された興味ある分野のうち「combinatorics」に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19071v1.title: Floer 永続バーコードの永続エントロピー
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19071v1.summary: 本論文では、作用濾過付き Floer ホモロジーを定量的に記述する Floer 永続バーコードに対し、トポロジカルデータ解析における Shannon エントロピーに想を得た新たな不変量「永続エントロピー (persistent entropy)」を導入した。これはバーの長さの分布の反復下における漸近的線形成長率を測定するもので、バーの数の指数成長率を記録する既存の「バーコード・エントロピー」を補完する概念である。ハミルトン微分同相写像における両エントロピーの一致や、Liouville 領域における比較不等式の証明、負曲率多様体の余接円盤束における測地流の位相的エントロピーとの関連性の算出を行った。また、Hofer 安定性評価や Reeb 流における柔軟性・剛性問題についても論じている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19071v1.appendix: ハミルトン系の反復や位相的エントロピー、力学系の不変量を扱う本論文の内容は、興味ある分野のうち「complex dynamics」などの動力学に関連する分野と理論的な接点を持っています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19045v1.title: ハイブリッドMittag-Leffler-Caputo-Fabrizio作用素を用いた分数的SVIR感染症モデルに対する構造保存スキーム
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19045v1.summary: 本研究では、非特異核を持つハイブリッドMittag-Leffler-Caputo-Fabrizio (MLCF) 分数階作用素を用いた分数階SVIR感染症モデルを提案し、その解析を行っている。このモデルは感染症伝播における短期および長期の記憶効果を考慮しており、分数階Gronwallの不等式を用いて解の正値性と有界性を証明した。基本再生産数 R₀ の導出、平衡点の安定性解析を、ヤコビ行列、対数リヤプノフ関数、分数階LaSalleの不変原理を用いて厳密に実施した。数値解法として、定性的特性を保存し、完全陰解法において無条件安定な θ 重み付き非標準有限差分 (NSFD) 法を開発した。数値実験や分岐解析を通じて、分数階パラメータの影響と手法の有効性を検証している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19045v1.appendix: 本論文は「validated numerics」に深く関連する、数値計算における定性的構造保存（正値性や有界性の維持）を扱っています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19017v1.title: Probabilistic Boolean Tapesに対する完全性
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19017v1.summary: 有限確率プログラミングのストリング図的基盤として提案された確率的ブール回路について、マルコフ核（Markov kernels）を意味論とする完全な公理系を提示する。この成果は、部分ブール回路の完全性、およびrig圏の図式的言語である確率的ブールテープの完全性という2つの中間的な結果に基づいている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19017v1.appendix: 本論文は計算の図式的表現や公理化を扱っており、形式言語や計算理論の基盤に関わる点でautomata theoryやformal languagesの分野と関連があります。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18938v1.title: スライディング運動を伴う区分的に滑らかなベクトル場に対するシャドウイング定理について
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18938v1.summary: 本論文は、異なる状態間を遷移するダイナミクスを持つ、区分的に滑らかなベクトル場（Filippovシステム）におけるシャドウイング定理の確立を目的としている。まず、従来のC²クラスのベクトル場で一般的に用いられる仮定だけでは、区分的に滑らかな設定において同様の結果が得られないことを反証例によって示す。その後、適切な仮定の下で、この枠組みに特化したシャドウイング型の定理を証明する。さらに、C²設定では現れない、区分的に滑らかなベクトル場特有の現象を捉えるための複数の拡張についても提案している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18938v1.appendix: 本論文で扱われるシャドウイング特性は、計算機による近似解の近傍に真の軌道が存在することを保証する理論的根拠を与えるものであり、興味ある分野の中では「validated numerics（精度保証付き数値計算）」と強い関連があります。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18926v1.title: 力学系におけるブランケット時間
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18926v1.summary: 本論文では、典型的な軌道に沿った経験分布が不変測度に近似される速さを定量化する「動的ブランケット時間（dynamical blanket times）」を導入した。これは、空間内で軌道が稠密になる速さを測る「動的カバー時間」の測度論的な類似概念である。有限枝を持つ一様拡大区間写像において、期待ブランケット時間の上限を空間スケールと近似精度を用いて導出し、不変測度がルベーグ測度に対して絶対連続な場合には、十分小さなスケールにおいて期待ブランケット時間と期待カバー時間が比較可能であることを示した。解析手法として、ターゲットの位置と空間スケールに関して一様な到達時間の大きな偏差の見積もりと、多重フラクタル解析を用いた不変測度の離散化モデルを組み合わせている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18926v1.appendix: 本論文は、symbolic dynamicsの分野と深く関連しており、特に力学系の軌道の統計的性質や分布の収束速度を扱う研究に位置づけられます。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18880v1.title: SL₂(O) および PSL₂(O₂) 上のエンゲル語の全射性
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18880v1.summary: 本論文では、局所環上の線形群におけるエンゲル語写像 eₘ(x, y) = [[...[x, y], y], ..., y] の全射性について研究している。具体的には、完備局所主イデアル環 O または有限長の局所主イデアル環 O_ℓ 上の SL₂(R) および PSL₂(R) を対象としている。剰余体 k ≅ F_q の標数が 2 でないという条件のもと、q が十分に大きい（q ≥ q₀(m)）ならば、SL₂(k) の非スカラー元の SL₂(O) へのすべての持ち上げが第 m 次エンゲル語写像の像に含まれることを示した。さらに、長さ 2 の局所主イデアル環 O₂ 上の PSL₂(O₂) において、すべてのエンゲル語写像が全射であることを証明した。本成果は、体上のエンゲル語写像に関する既存の結果を一般化するものである。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18880v1.appendix: 本論文は線形代数群および環上の群構造を扱っており、興味ある分野として挙げられた「structure of large countable infinite group」に関連する可能性があります。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18878v1.title: 複雑イベント認識のための計算可能なギャップ制約付き言語
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18878v1.summary: 文字列uの文字列Dへの部分列埋め込みにおいて、埋め込まれた文字間の要因が特定の正則言語Lに属することを要求する「ギャップ制約」付き部分列照合問題を検討している。一般にこの問題はNP完全であるが、本論文では「左凸性（left-convexity）」という新しい性質を持つ言語（uvw ∈ L かつ v ∈ L ならば uv ∈ L）を提案した。左凸言語は長さ制約など実用的なシナリオを表現可能であり、これを用いることで、任意のインターフェース構造を持つ制約に対して、SETHの下で最適に近い時間計算量 O(|D| (|u| + |C|)) で照合および列挙が可能であることを示した。一方で、非左凸言語を導入すると再びNP完全になることも示している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18878v1.appendix: この論文は、正則言語のクラスやその組合せ論的性質を扱っているため、automata theory および combinatorics on words と深く関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19399v1.title: VERITAS: ゼロショット形式定理証明のための検証器誘導型証明探索
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19399v1.summary: LLMを用いた形式定理証明において、検証器から得られる詳細な信号（構文エラー、型不一致、部分的なゴールの進捗）を単なる成否判定に留めず、証明探索のガイドとして活用するフレームワーク「VERITAS」を提案する。この手法は、Best-of-Nサンプリングを行う第1フェーズと、その失敗例を負の例として明示的に取り入れる批判モデル（Critic）誘導型のモンテカルロ木探索（MCTS）を行う第2フェーズの2段階プロトコルで構成される。miniF2Fベンチマークで40.6%の正解率を達成したほか、新たに導入した55の組合せ論問題からなる「VERITAS-CombiBench」において、検証器のフィードバックから補題名を反復的に特定する探索の有効性を示した。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19399v1.appendix: 本論文は組合せ論のベンチマークである「VERITAS-CombiBench」をリリースしており、興味ある分野の「combinatorics on words」を含む組合せ論全般に関連があります。また、証明の形式検証プロセスは「formal languages」や「automata theory」の応用領域としての側面も持っています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18754v1.title: 白黒格子上のDyckパス
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18754v1.summary: Dyckパスは、(0,0)から(n,n)へ至る(1,0)の右ステップと(0,1)の上ステップn個ずつからなり、直線y=xを超えない格子パスである。これらはカタラン数により数え上げられ、数え上げ組合せ論において中心的な役割を果たす。本論文では、整数格子をチェスボード状および列交互の2つのパターンで白黒に彩色し、パスの下にある白と黒のセルの数が等しくなるようなDyckパスの数え上げを行う。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18754v1.appendix: 数え上げ組合せ論や格子パスを扱う本研究は、興味ある分野のうち「combinatorics on words」と関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18685v1.title: 微分方程式の帰納的頑健性の公理化
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18685v1.summary: 本研究は、有界時間領域における多項式微分方程式を持つ動的システムの頑健な安全性（robust safety）に対する完全な公理化を確立したものである。安全性の性質を多項式不変量の公理系へと一律に還元し、論理的証明を可能にしている。また、任意の摂動パラメータ δ に対して、頑健な安全性の記号的証明を生成するか、あるいは δ レベルの摂動下で安全でないことを正しく判定する、近似的可決定なアルゴリズムを提示している。劣解析幾何学（subanalytic geometry）の結果を活用することで、境界での正の分離を必要とせずに、任意の有界な半代数的初期・終了条件に対する厳密さを維持した証明を可能とし、ハイブリッド動的システムにおける有限時間を超えた帰納的安全性の生成を実現している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18685v1.appendix: 本論文は「validated numerics」の分野に関連しています。動的システムの安全性に対する近似的可決定性の検討や、摂動パラメータを用いた計算手法は、精度保証付き数値計算の概念と深く関わっています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18674v1.title: SO(n, 1) の幾何学的有限な thin subgroup に対する Selberg の 3/16 定理の一般化
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18674v1.summary: 本論文では、算術的格子 Γ₀ < SO(n, 1) の幾何学的有限な thin subgroup である Γ について、その合同被覆における一様なスペクトルギャップの問題を扱っています。Bourgain-Gamburd-Sarnak による先行研究では、SL₂(ℝ) かつ臨界指数 δ_Γ > 1/2 の場合に一様なスペクトルギャップが示され、軌道へのアフィン篩法などの応用が示されました。本研究は、特に n ≥ 3 かつカスプが存在する場合に未解決であった δ_Γ ∈ (1/2, n - 2] という領域に焦点を当てています。カスプの存在に起因する可算無限のコーディングを扱うため、帰還軌道部分群の Zariski 稠密性および全トレース体性を証明する新しい手法を導入し、既存の理論の空白を埋めています。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18674v1.appendix: 本論文は、カスプを持つ群のコーディング（countably infinite coding）を扱っており、興味ある分野のうち「structure of large countable infinite group」および「symbolic dynamics」に関連しています。

papers.title: Planar constant piecewise smooth vector fields with large hysteresis
papers.summary:
Throughout this work, we will carry out a rigorous mathematical analysis of a class of control systems that is widely used in applications but still lacks a consistent theoretical foundation for describing the types of limit sets that may arise from its dynamics. There are applications in which, for example, a treatment for a given disease is administered until the level of diseased cells falls below a prescribed threshold C1. At that point, the treatment is suspended in order to allow the patient's organism to recover from its side effects. Subsequently, when the level of diseased cells reaches a second threshold C2 bigger than C1, the treatment is resumed, and the protocol is repeated. To the best of our knowledge, there is not a mathematical classification of such models.
  In this paper, we initiate what is intended to become a consistent body of literature aimed at determining the limit sets of such models. We begin with the planar case, in which two linear vector fields are active and two switching boundaries are considered. Naturally, in future developments, control systems in higher dimensions, featuring additional vector fields and more general switching manifolds, should also be considered.

papers.title: Strong non-principality of positive codegree Turán density
papers.summary:
The \emph{minimum positive codegree} $δ^+_{k-1}(G)$ of a $k$-graph $G$ is the minimum, over all $(k-1)$-sets that lie in at least one edge, of the number of edges containing that set. The \emph{positive codegree Turán density} of a $k$-graph family $\mathcal{F}$ is the asymptotically maximum value of $δ^+_{k-1}(G)/n$ over all $\mathcal{F}$-free $k$-graphs $G$ with $n\to\infty$ vertices. In this note, we establish a strong version of non-principality with respect to this density by proving that for every $k\ge3$ there exist two $k$-graphs $F_1$ and $F_2$ such that
  $$
  0<γ^+(F_1, F_2) < \min\{γ^+(F_1), γ^+(F_2)\}.
  $$

papers.title: A-COMPASS: Formal Foundations for Anonymity Analysis in Microdata
papers.summary: In the information age, one of the leading problems is how to ensure individual's privacy. Depending on the context in which privacy is considered, various data privacy models have emerged. However, the domain of formal verification of these models is still not sufficiently explored even when it comes to the most basic models. An attempt to verify privacy requirements is the Compliance Assertion Language (COMPASS). In COMPASS, one can specify an anonymity condition that a table needs to satisfy, and an action that will modify the table if the condition is not satisfied. It is designed to operate on preprocessed tables in a form one record - one group of people. In this paper, we modify the COMPASS language in order to operate on microdata tables in their usual form of one record - one person. The modified language is called A-COMPASS. Along with checking of previously applied anonymity conditions, A-COMPASS enables the execution of anonymization actions as a new feature. We further provide the syntax and the semantics for the A-COMPASS language. We also prove the most important properties of the introduced semantics like determinism and compositionality. Finally, we provide a mechanism to verify anonymity properties, such as k-anonymity and l-diversity.

papers.title: Rigidity of coarsely minimal Reeb flows
papers.summary: We introduce the notion of a coarsely minimal Reeb flow, generalizing the notion of minimal geodesic flow, and prove the following rigidity theorem: That a coarsely minimal Reeb flow satisfying a divergence property is orbitally equivalent to the geodesic flow of a Riemannian metric of negative sectional curvature. Without the divergence assumption, we obtain an orbital semi-equivalence. This extends a rigidity result for geodesic flows of negatively curved Riemannian metrics which is due to Gromov. We use Floer homology and Morse's hyperbolic `stability' Lemma.

papers.title: Lacunary hyperbolic groups with fast injectivity radius growth and enough loxodromic elements are selfless
papers.summary: We prove that a lacunary hyperbolic group $G = \varinjlim G_i$ with sufficient generics is selfless in the sense of Amrutam--Gao--Kunnawalkam Elayavalli--Patchell, provided the hyperbolicity constants $δ_i$ and injectivity radii $r_i$ satisfy $δ_i(\log r_i)^{7} = o(r_i)$. The proof replaces the acylindricity-based machinery of that work with a direct geodesic $n$-gon criterion due to Arzhantseva, which applies in any $δ$-hyperbolic space. As a consequence, combined with rapid decay, $G$ is $C^*$-selfless. The condition is mild: torsion-free Tarski monsters, Jacobson's mixed-identity-free elementary amenable groups and Gromov monster groups satisfy it for appropriate parameter choices. The amenable examples are selfless but cannot be $C^*$-selfless, providing examples that separate these properties. Finally we remark that the Gromov monster group examples provide a potential avenue to a non-exact $C^*$-algebra with strict comparison.

papers.title: Minimality of Random Moore Automata under Prefix-Dependent Congruences
papers.summary: We study prefix-dependent congruences for random deterministic transition systems with state outputs. In this setting, the admissible continuations used to compare two states may depend on the observed prefix, and two states are identified only if no common admissible continuation distinguishes their future outputs. The framework includes probabilistic deterministic finite automata as a motivating special case. We analyze the random transition model in which all transition values are independent and uniform. Each state is also assigned an independent label that specifies both its output and its set of admissible symbols. If two independent labels agree with probability strictly less than one, and every label has at least three admissible symbols, then the induced congruence is trivial with high probability. The proof combines a pruning process on pairs, a collision-free exploration controlling its early evolution, and a first-moment argument showing that the remaining pairs cannot organize into nontrivial equivalence classes.

papers.title: Tree-cut decompositions for displaying undominated edge-ends
papers.summary: We prove that every graph admits a linked, componental, rooted tree-cut decomposition of finite adhesion that displays all undominated edge-ends. As a first application, we deduce that this tree-cut decomposition also displays the edge-degrees of all undominated edge-ends.
